steps.name: run-stage16d-dagger-tradeoff-confirmation
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=698d4e7e31a192a19b9f18cc0d11ea7a1a146fa6; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; rm -f warnings.txt; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage16/stage16c_sequence_dagger_iter1_dev.py > /tmp/stage16d-dagger-tradeoff-confirmation.py; .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/tmp/stage16d-dagger-tradeoff-confirmation.py')
s = p.read_text()
old = 'DEV_SEED = 282_843'
new = 'DEV_SEED = 331_643'
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('expected Stage 16C DEV seed declaration not found')
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new, 1))
PY
.venv/bin/python -m py_compile /tmp/stage16d-dagger-tradeoff-confirmation.py; PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python /tmp/stage16d-dagger-tradeoff-confirmation.py; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
